hook.text: Cattle grazing under scattered trees gain more weight than cattle on open pasture. Shade reduces heat stress.

buildup.text: Silvopasture combines trees, forage grasses, and livestock on the same land. Each element benefits the others.

discovery.text: Trees provide shade and shelter. Cattle fertilize the soil. Grass protects tree roots from compaction.

twist.text: Project Drawdown ranks silvopasture as one of the top climate solutions—sequestering carbon in both trees and soil.

climax.text: In Colombia, silvopasture farms produce 4× more milk per hectare than treeless pastures.

punchline.text: Add trees to pasture. Happier cows. More milk. Stored carbon. Everyone wins.

quiz.question: Why do cattle perform better in silvopasture systems?
options: Tree shade reduces heat stress, improving weight gain and milk production
